content: We assess the summarization performance of our models on two benchmark datasets: the CNN/DailyMail (CNNDM) dataset BIBREF34, BIBREF11 and the New York Times (NYT) dataset BIBREF35. We pre-train our models on the GIGA-CM dataset introduced in zhang-etal-2019-hibert.
